title: Configurable object
idea: Configurable object: A consistent object view accompanies a short variation selector and explicit consequences for size, compatibility or finish.
audience: People who need to configure product within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: A small supported variation set materially changes fit.
avoidWhen: Too many unsupported combinations would imply a custom manufacturing promise.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic artifact layout through its configure product priority and explicit commitment contract: Show only supported combinations and distinguish visualization from exact finish proof.
navigation: Configurable object keeps the current configure product context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A consistent object view accompanies a short variation selector and explicit consequences for size, compatibility or finish.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to configure product; a small supported variation set materially changes fit.
composition.priority: Show only supported combinations and distinguish visualization from exact finish proof.

imagery.role: Support the actual configure product context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep selected attributes visible beneath the object and group options by decision.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the configurable object structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no configure product content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Show only supported combinations and distinguish visualization from exact finish proof.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized configure product content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Show only supported combinations and distinguish visualization from exact finish proof.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active configure product context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
